idea-plugin.name: TruthSpine Connector
idea-plugin.description:
Whole project truth for every AI you use. On your computer. 14-day free trial, then $99.99 once, down from $249.99 for a limited time.

You lead the work. TruthSpine keeps the truth.

The keeper of your project. One checked record of what was decided, what was done, what failed and what comes next. Every connected chat starts already knowing your project. Your project stays on your computer. You lead the work. TruthSpine keeps the truth.

This plugin connects your JetBrains IDE's AI chat to TruthSpine. Say "Connect TruthSpine" once in a chat, and it knows your project.

  • Connects the project you have open, and only after you say yes. It never looks through the rest of your computer.
  • The first time, it offers to get the TruthSpine app: the Microsoft Store on Windows, the App Store on Mac, truthspine.app on Linux.
  • Copies the short "Connect TruthSpine" phrase for you when a chat needs it.

This plugin is the connector, not the TruthSpine app. When you open a store page from it, it tells our license server which page it opened. It never sends your project or where it is on your computer.

This connector is free (Apache License 2.0). It needs the TruthSpine app, which you get and buy separately. Installing the connector does not start a trial or need its own license.

On Windows, start the free 14-day trial in the TruthSpine app. Then buy once in the Microsoft Store: $99.99 at the launch price (regular price $249.99), for V1 and every 1.x update. Reinstalling does not restart the trial.

On Mac, start the free 14-day trial in the TruthSpine app. Then buy once in the App Store: $99.99 at the launch price (regular price $249.99), for V1 and every 1.x update. Restore Purchases brings it back on your other Macs.

On Linux, the TruthSpine AppImage from truthspine.app starts with a free 14-day trial. Then buy once from us: $99.99 at the launch price (regular price $249.99), for V1 and every 1.x update, on up to three of your own Linux computers. You can move it between them in the app.

Future major versions are sold separately.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Offers TruthSpine on Linux: Get TruthSpine opens the AppImage download on truthspine.app (sold directly by TimeProofLabs), and the plugin connects once the AppImage has run on this computer.
  • Scopes approval to the displayed folder and requests approval again when that scope changes.
  • Uses the IDE project path directly and never searches the whole computer automatically.
  • Checks queued acquisition-resume state and distinguishes an opening request from a completed connection.
  • Keeps a persistent first-run setup action visible until the protected desktop app is detected.
  • Preserves the free connector boundary: trial, purchase, restore, and licensing remain owned by the protected desktop app and its app store.
